content.description: A complete introduction to COBOL, the language that still powers the world's banking and government systems.

COBOL may be over 60 years old, but it still processes an estimated 95% of ATM transactions and 80% of in-person financial transactions worldwide. content.title: COBOL Scripting and Batch Processing
content.description: Take your COBOL skills further with real-world batch processing, JCL integration, and report generation.
content.course_content:
[{"type": "learning_point", "value": "Batch processing concepts and job scheduling", "id": "4aa53048-a84e-41e0-b04f-017a6e38059d"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Introduction to JCL (Job Control Language)", "id": "5fc99e2b-876f-4642-9cc3-dc0e49af3ba9"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Reading and writing VSAM datasets", "id": "782e82e8-6ea7-4746-b994-f8781d592591"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Table handling with OCCURS and SEARCH", "id": "bc044db1-2ad1-4746-8534-49ecf3a325d0"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Generating formatted business reports", "id": "e794174f-310a-4234-b02e-0f2acafdf4ba"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Debugging techniques and common COBOL pitfalls", "id": "70d8d16a-f828-41c9-bbcb-8453d66fba09"}, {"type": "heading", "value": "Course Content", "id": "faaac82a-81a6-4b8e-8c1f-f88b6394bf1c"}, {"type": "paragraph", "value": "

Most COBOL code runs in batch \u2014 millions of transactions processed overnight while the rest of the world sleeps. This course teaches you how that actually works. You'll learn to write JCL scripts that control job execution, process large datasets using VSAM, and generate the kind of formatted reports that banks and insurance companies rely on daily. We also cover table handling, which is essential for any real-world COBOL application, and practical debugging strategies for when things go wrong at 2 AM. If COBOL Fundamentals gave you the language, this course gives you the environment. By the end, you'll understand not just how to write COBOL, but how it fits into the mainframe ecosystem that still runs global finance.

", "id": "62bb4ceb-8415-4f6b-8531-568f4933fdf7"}]

content.title: About
content.body:
LearnHub is a digital learning platform built by students who believe quality education should be accessible, practical, and straight to the point.

Our platform offers two learning tracks: Programming & QA for those building a career in tech, and COBOL for developers who want to work with the enterprise systems that still power global finance. Every course is designed with real-world application in mind — no filler, no fluff.

LearnHub started as a university project exploring how modern web technologies can be used to deliver educational content. Built with Django and Wagtail CMS, the platform itself is a demonstration of the tools and principles we teach: clean architecture, maintainable code, and thoughtful design.

Whether you're writing your first Python script or learning how batch processing runs overnight at a major bank, LearnHub gives you the knowledge and confidence to take the next step.

content.title: FAQ Page
content.introduction: Got questions? Here are the most common ones. If you don't find what you're looking for, reach out through our contact page.

faq_items.question: How do I access my courses after purchase?
faq_items.answer: After purchasing a course, log in to your account and navigate to your dashboard. All your purchased courses will be available immediately for streaming. You can access them from any device with a browser.

faq_items.question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faq_items.answer: Yes. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all individual course purchases. If a course doesn't meet your expectations, contact us and we'll process your refund with no questions asked. Subscription refunds are prorated based on usage.

faq_items.question: What's the difference between buying a single course and subscribing?
faq_items.answer: Buying a single course gives you lifetime access to that specific course. The Pro subscription gives you access to all courses on the platform for a monthly fee, and the Lifetime plan gives you permanent access to everything, including future courses.

faq_items.question: Do I get a certificate after completing a course?
faq_items.answer: Certificates of completion are available for Pro and Lifetime members. Complete all course modules and pass the final assessment to receive a downloadable certificate you can share on LinkedIn or include in your portfolio.

faq_items.question: Are the COBOL courses relevant for today's job market?
faq_items.answer: Absolutely. COBOL still processes around 95% of ATM transactions and 80% of in-person financial transactions globally. Banks, insurance companies, and government agencies are actively hiring COBOL developers as the existing workforce retires. It's one of the most in-demand and least competitive skill sets in enterprise IT.

faq_items.question: I'm a complete beginner. Which course should I start with?
faq_items.answer: If you're new to programming, start with Python for Beginners. Python is widely considered the most beginner-friendly language and the concepts you learn there will transfer to any other language. If you're specifically interested in enterprise and mainframe development, you can move to COBOL Fundamentals after that.

content.description: Take your COBOL skills further with real-world batch processing, JCL integration, and report generation.
content.course_content:
[{"type": "learning_point", "value": "Batch processing concepts and job scheduling", "id": "4aa53048-a84e-41e0-b04f-017a6e38059d"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Introduction to JCL (Job Control Language)", "id": "5fc99e2b-876f-4642-9cc3-dc0e49af3ba9"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Reading and writing VSAM datasets", "id": "782e82e8-6ea7-4746-b994-f8781d592591"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Table handling with OCCURS and SEARCH", "id": "bc044db1-2ad1-4746-8534-49ecf3a325d0"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Generating formatted business reports", "id": "e794174f-310a-4234-b02e-0f2acafdf4ba"}, {"type": "learning_point", "value": "Debugging techniques and common COBOL pitfalls", "id": "70d8d16a-f828-41c9-bbcb-8453d66fba09"}, {"type": "heading", "value": "Course Content", "id": "faaac82a-81a6-4b8e-8c1f-f88b6394bf1c"}, {"type": "paragraph", "value": "

Most COBOL code runs in batch \u2014 millions of transactions processed overnight while the rest of the world sleeps. This course teaches you how that actually works. You'll learn to write JCL scripts that control job execution, process large datasets using VSAM, and generate the kind of formatted reports that banks and insurance companies rely on daily. We also cover table handling, which is essential for any real-world COBOL application, and practical debugging strategies for when things go wrong at 2 AM. If COBOL Fundamentals gave you the language, this course gives you the environment. By the end, you'll understand not just how to write COBOL, but how it fits into the mainframe ecosystem that still runs global finance.

", "id": "62bb4ceb-8415-4f6b-8531-568f4933fdf7"}]

content.description: Take your COBOL skills further with real-world batch processing, JCL integration, and report generation.

Most COBOL code runs in batch \u2014 millions of transactions processed overnight while the rest of the world sleeps. This course teaches you how that actually works. content.title: About
content.body:
LearnHub is a digital learning platform built by students who believe quality education should be accessible, practical, and straight to the point.

Our platform offers two learning tracks: Programming & QA for those building a career in tech, and COBOL for developers who want to work with the enterprise systems that still power global finance. Every course is designed with real-world application in mind — no filler, no fluff.

LearnHub started as a university project exploring how modern web technologies can be used to deliver educational content. Built with Django and Wagtail CMS, the platform itself is a demonstration of the tools and principles we teach: clean architecture, maintainable code, and thoughtful design.

Whether you're writing your first Python script or learning how batch processing runs overnight at a major bank, LearnHub gives you the knowledge and confidence to take the next step.

content.title: FAQ Page
content.introduction: Got questions ? Here are the most common ones. If you don't find what you're looking for, reach out through our contact page.

faq_items.question: How do I access my courses after purchase?
faq_items.answer: After purchasing a course, log in to your account and navigate to your dashboard. All your purchased courses will be available immediately for streaming. You can access them from any device with a browser.

faq_items.question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faq_items.answer: Yes. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all individual course purchases. If a course doesn't meet your expectations, contact us and we'll process your refund with no questions asked. Subscription refunds are prorated based on usage.

faq_items.question: What's the difference between buying a single course and subscribing?
faq_items.answer: Buying a single course gives you lifetime access to that specific course. The Pro subscription gives you access to all courses on the platform for a monthly fee, and the Lifetime plan gives you permanent access to everything, including future courses.

faq_items.question: Do I get a certificate after completing a course?
faq_items.answer: Certificates of completion are available for Pro and Lifetime members. Complete all course modules and pass the final assessment to receive a downloadable certificate you can share on LinkedIn or include in your portfolio.

faq_items.question: Are the COBOL courses relevant for today's job market?
faq_items.answer: Absolutely. COBOL still processes around 95% of ATM transactions and 80% of in-person financial transactions globally. Banks, insurance companies, and government agencies are actively hiring COBOL developers as the existing workforce retires. It's one of the most in-demand and least competitive skill sets in enterprise IT.

faq_items.question: I'm a complete beginner. Which course should I start with?
faq_items.answer: If you're new to programming, start with Python for Beginners. Python is widely considered the most beginner-friendly language and the concepts you learn there will transfer to any other language. If you're specifically interested in enterprise and mainframe development, you can move to COBOL Fundamentals after that.

fields.body:
LearnHub is a digital learning platform built by students who believe quality education should be accessible, practical, and straight to the point.

Our platform offers two learning tracks: Programming & QA for those building a career in tech, and COBOL for developers who want to work with the enterprise systems that still power global finance. Every course is designed with real-world application in mind — no filler, no fluff.

LearnHub started as a university project exploring how modern web technologies can be used to deliver educational content. Built with Django and Wagtail CMS, the platform itself is a demonstration of the tools and principles we teach: clean architecture, maintainable code, and thoughtful design.

Whether you're writing your first Python script or learning how batch processing runs overnight at a major bank, LearnHub gives you the knowledge and confidence to take the next step.

fields.question: How do I access my courses after purchase ?
fields.answer: After purchasing a course, log in to your account and navigate to your dashboard. All your purchased courses will be available immediately for streaming. You can access them from any device with a browser.

fields.question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied ?
fields.answer: Yes. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all individual course purchases. If a course doesn't meet your expectations, contact us and we'll process your refund with no questions asked. Subscription refunds are prorated based on usage.

fields.question: What's the difference between buying a single course and subscribing ?
fields.answer: Buying a single course gives you lifetime access to that specific course. The Pro subscription gives you access to all courses on the platform for a monthly fee, and the Lifetime plan gives you permanent access to everything, including future courses.

fields.question: Do I get a certificate after completing a course ?
fields.answer: Certificates of completion are available for Pro and Lifetime members. Complete all course modules and pass the final assessment to receive a downloadable certificate you can share on LinkedIn or include in your portfolio.

fields.question: Are the COBOL courses relevant for today's job market ?
fields.answer: Absolutely. COBOL still processes around 95% of ATM transactions and 80% of in-person financial transactions globally. Banks, insurance companies, and government agencies are actively hiring COBOL developers as the existing workforce retires. It's one of the most in-demand and least competitive skill sets in enterprise IT.

fields.question: I'm a complete beginner. Which course should I start with ?
fields.answer: If you're new to programming, start with Python for Beginners. Python is widely considered the most beginner-friendly language and the concepts you learn there will transfer to any other language. If you're specifically interested in enterprise and mainframe development, you can move to COBOL Fundamentals after that.
